name: Mexico
uniques: Earn [100]% of killed [Military] unit's [Strength] as [Culture]
startIntroPart1: Benito Juárez, president of Mexico, leads a proud people whose roots reach back to the Aztec and Maya empires. Through revolution and resilience, Mexico forged a nation of vibrant culture, ancient pyramids and mariachi songs.

declaringWar: Mexico does not fear war. We have fought for our freedom before, and we will do it again!

defeated: Mexico falls today, but its spirit will rise again.
introduction: Greetings. I am Benito Juárez, president of Mexico.
tradeRequest: Let us trade, friend. Mexico has much to offer.

startIntroPart1: Abraham Lincoln, president of the United States, leads a nation built on liberty and the pursuit of happiness. From thirteen colonies, America grew into a land of industry, freedom and opportunity.

attacked: You have made a grave mistake.
defeated: The Union falls, but the idea of America lives on.

tradeRequest: America is open for business. Shall we trade?
